title: Kitchen before and after
alt: Before and after of a kitchen corner. The upper photo shows oak units, a dark worktop and a multicoloured tile splashback, with dust sheets over the counters. The lower photo shows the same kitchen with the walls painted and a white tiled splashback.
caption: A kitchen Martin redecorated. The finished photograph shows painted walls and a white tiled splashback where the multicoloured tiles had been. The oak units stayed as they were.

title: Loft bedroom before and after
alt: Before and after collage of a loft bedroom. The top photos show grey prepared walls, an oak slat panel around a fireplace opening, and the room mid-decoration. The large lower photo shows black wallpaper with gold markings, a recessed shelf and the slatted panel.
caption: Loft bedroom. The earlier photos show the grey prepared walls. The finished room has black and gold wallpaper, with the oak slat panel kept as a feature.

title: Loft wall with oak slats, before and after
alt: Before and after of a loft bedroom wall. The top photo shows a grey filled wall, a chest of drawers and oak slats fixed on the right. The bottom photo shows black and gold wallpaper, a slatted shelf niche over the radiator, and a full-height oak slat wall beside a white door.
caption: The other end of the same loft bedroom. Wallpaper is cut around the slope, with oak slat panelling beside the bed wall.

title: Downstairs toilet before and after
alt: Before and after of a small downstairs toilet. The left photo shows plain cream walls, a wooden window and a white toilet. The right photo shows the same room papered in a dark floral design with large pink and burgundy flowers.
caption: Downstairs toilet. Plain painted walls on the left, dark floral paper across the room on the right.

title: Living room before and after
alt: Before and after of a living room with a white fireplace. The top photo shows peach walls with filler spots and a strip of old brown floral wallpaper on the chimney breast. The bottom photo shows fern-pattern wallpaper on both side walls and the chimney breast painted a plain light grey.
caption: Living room. The first photo still has filler on the walls and a strip of old paper on the chimney. The second has fern wallpaper either side of a plain painted chimney breast.

title: Dining room feature wall, before and after
alt: Split photograph of a dining room. The upper half shows a finished wall of green wallpaper patterned with framed animal portraits, beside a dining table. The lower half shows that wall earlier, pale and unpapered, with chairs under plastic and a stepladder.
caption: Dining-room feature wall. One wall is hung with a busy animal-portrait paper. The return wall, shown in the next photograph, is painted a dusky pink.

title: Entrance hall before and after
alt: Hallway with cream floral stripe wallpaper above grey panelled wainscot, a wooden front door and a side window. An inset photo shows the same hallway earlier, with plain cream walls and the panelling already in place.
caption: Entrance hall. Floral paper hung above the panels. The inset is the hall before the paper went on.

title: Panelled hallway before and after
alt: Hallway with cream floral stripe wallpaper above grey panelling and two oak doors. An inset shows the hallway earlier, painted a plain warm yellow, with tools on the floor.
caption: A panelled hallway after floral paper was hung above the dado. The inset shows it painted a plain yellow beforehand.

title: Leaf wallpaper above a painted dado
alt: Kitchen and dining wall finished with leaf-pattern wallpaper above a grey painted dado. An inset photo shows the same wall earlier, with damaged plaster above a pink dado.
caption: Leaf-pattern paper above a painted dado. The inset is the wall before it was made good and papered.

title: Fireplace surround painted
alt: Collage of a timber fireplace surround being painted. Smaller photos show the surround in its wood finish and then in white in the room. The large photo shows the surround and the mirror frame above it painted a warm off-white, with the black electric fire still in place.
caption: Fireplace surround and the mirror frame above it, painted from bare timber to a warm white.

title: Art-deco wallpaper in a living room
alt: Living room wall with metallic gold art-deco fan wallpaper above a beige painted dado and a reddish wooden door with a floral wreath. An inset photo shows the room earlier, with different paper still on the wall and furniture pushed together.
caption: Art-deco fan paper above a painted dado. The inset shows the room earlier, before that paper was finished around the door.

title: Kitchen after the walls were finished
alt: Finished kitchen with oak units, a dark worktop, a white tiled splashback, a sink under the window and a black dishwasher.
caption: The same kitchen after the walls and splashback were finished, looking along the sink run.

title: Dining room with paper and pink paint
alt: Dining room with green animal-portrait wallpaper on the left wall and a dusky pink painted wall on the right, with a wooden door, a large station clock and a dining table.
caption: The dining room finished: paper on one wall, dusky pink paint on the other.

title: Finished loft bedroom
alt: Finished loft bedroom with black and gold wallpaper, a timber shelf niche above a radiator, an oak slat wall to the right and a bed in the foreground.
caption: The loft bedroom made up, with the feature paper stopped at the slope of the ceiling.

title: Oak slat wall behind the bed
alt: Loft bedroom wall of vertical oak slats behind a dark slatted headboard, with black and gold wallpaper on the sloping ceiling edges and white doors either side.
caption: Oak slat wall behind the bed, with the dark paper kept to the slopes above it.

title: Cloakroom in floral paper and burgundy paint
alt: Downstairs toilet doorway with dark floral wallpaper on the left, a deep burgundy painted wall on the right, and a small inset photo of the same space when the walls were plain.
caption: The cloakroom from the doorway: floral paper on the walls you see first, burgundy paint on the return, and the plain room inset as it was.

title: Willow-leaf feature wall
alt: Bedroom with one sloped wall covered in brown and cream willow-leaf wallpaper, the other walls painted white, a black metal bed, matching curtains at the window, and two rolls of the same paper lying on the bed.
caption: One feature wall of willow-leaf paper. The other walls are left painted so the pattern does the work.

title: Marble-effect hallway and stairs
alt: Hallway with a grey carpeted staircase and white spindles on the left, and a wall of beige and grey marble-effect wallpaper on the right. White marble-pattern floor tiles run down the hall.
caption: Staircase and hall. Marble-effect paper on the long wall, woodwork painted white.

title: Floral wallpaper above hallway panelling
alt: Hallway with large cream floral wallpaper above grey-blue panelling, oak doors and a tiled floor.
caption: Floral paper kept above the dado, with the panels and doors as the quieter half of the hall.

title: Panelled stairs with a black rail
alt: Staircase with cream raised-panel walls, a black handrail and black spindles, grey carpet, and a small wooden door under the stairs.
caption: Panelled stairwell painted in cream and stone, with the handrail and spindles finished in black.

title: Mottled paper above navy panelling
alt: Turn of a stairs with mottled grey and blush wallpaper above navy blue raised panelling, a wooden handrail on the left and a white glazed door on the right.
caption: Mottled paper above navy panelling at the turn of a stairs.

title: Hallway end wall in shimmering paper
alt: Looking along a hallway with white stair spindles, grey carpet and pale marble-effect wallpaper on the right wall. The far wall is papered in a shimmering cream and gold stripe.
caption: The end of a marble-effect hallway, closed with a shimmering stripe paper.

title: Botanical paper on a stairs
alt: Staircase during decoration. The walls are finished with sage green panelling below and a dense botanical wallpaper above. The stair treads are bare timber with carpet gripper rods still showing.
caption: Botanical paper and sage panelling on a stairs. The treads were still bare when this was taken, so it shows the walls rather than a finished carpet.

title: Ceiling filled before painting
alt: Dining room before decoration, with filler patches across the ceiling, pale walls, furniture wrapped in plastic and a large station clock.
caption: Ceiling filled and left to dry before paint. This photograph is the preparation, not the finished room.

title: Stair panelling part-way through
alt: Hall stairs being painted. White spindles and a handrail are finished, and the lower wall has beige raised panels. A paint-splattered stepladder and open paint tins stand in the hall. A small inset shows the stairs earlier, with blue walls and an unpainted timber handrail.
caption: Panelling on a stairs, part-way through. The inset is the earlier blue wall and bare timber rail.
